name: Ghost
description: Professional publishing platform: modern editor, memberships, paid newsletters, themes. The go-to open-source alternative to WordPress/Substack.
compose:
services:
  ghost:
    image: ghost:5
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:2368"
    environment:
      url: "${{cfg.url}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/ghost/content
    restart: unless-stopped
